lessons.trigger_condition: Screenshot-based request for multi-game detailed card price views while existing detail action only opened legacy search.
lessons.prevention_rule: Registry core/promoted market-capable only; WATCH remains quarantined; verified completed sales only without fabricated PSA/ROI/pop/FX.
validation_required: Exact identity by game/region/asset and card number/edition
Cross-source prices need matching SKU and dated evidence
All UI assets on local HTTP allowlist and offline PWA cache
Current-head CI before merge; physical Lenovo check separate
lessons.safety_boundary: Read-only source display, user-initiated device-local collection; no automatic non-core grading.
